audit_scope: Frozen case, formation, canonical packet, serialized job and transport inputs only; no responses or model scores read.
limitations: No model responses, model quality scores, transport outcomes, or runtime model identity were audited.
Operational oracle consistency is not independent human pedagogical ground truth or student learning gain.
Self-report versus assessment replaces the evidence channel and associated fields; it is not a single-field representation ablation.
Outcome-order and priority-order contrasts swap values at two positions; other single-factor contrasts change one input field.
Formal concept API receipts have session_id=null; ownership can be verified at learner/project/checkpoint, not as native same-session graded evidence.
Unrepresented remediation_started events are retained in normalization audits; complete canonical delivery is not complete delivery of every raw native event.
Both budgets preserve required sources in the audited sets; smaller budget primarily removes background records, not critical evidence.
Four conditions share base canonical fields and records; gated inputs intentionally add derived eligibility annotations.
Author-generated dev and formal fixtures are not independent human-authored tests. Families provide fewer independent units than repeated conditions.
Native Mutation serialized key order may change in JSON; Fact binding was checked by predicate/key/value and source IDs, not by re-enumerating sorted patch keys to reconstruct ordinal.
token_count_method: Independent cl100k_base count of ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, compact-separator JSON serialization of complete messages; not guaranteed to equal hosted provider tokenizer.
